description: Source code for the QuicCoalescedPacket class, which manages coalescing multiple QUIC packets into a single packet for efficient transmission.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: Manages coalescing multiple QUIC packets, handling encryption levels, addresses, and buffer management.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a given packet into the current coalesced packet, considering size, address, and encryption level constraints.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the coalesced packet state, clearing addresses, buffers, and counters.

methods.name: NeuterInitialPacket
methods.description: Removes the initial packet from the coalesced packet, updating length and transmission type accordingly.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies the encrypted buffers into a provided buffer, returning success status.

methods.name: ContainsPacketOfEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Checks if the coalesced packet contains a packet of a specific encryption level.

methods.name: TransmissionTypeOfPacket
methods.description: Returns the transmission type of a packet at a specific encryption level.

methods.name: NumberOfPackets
methods.description: Returns the total number of packets contained within the coalesced packet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the coalesced packet, including total length, padding, and encryption levels.

methods.name: packet_lengths
methods.description: Returns a vector of sizes representing the lengths of individual packets.
